entities.summary: Scott Ryan Williamson is an American former Major League Baseball (MLB) right-handed relief pitcher who played for the Cincinnati Reds (1999–2003), Boston Red Sox (2003–2004), Chicago Cubs (2005–2006), San Diego Padres (2006), and Baltimore Orioles (2007).
